name: Week 15 KB Conditioning — Thursday, Full Template (Spotlight: Windmill)
description: KB Thursday, full template — banded prep → strength block (lighter) → OTD flow → windmill spotlight → mobility → flow + balance → cooldown. Lighter on the loaded squatting (Friday legs is the day after). Spotlight cycles forward to the windmill (the lateral-hinge mobility move, due for a deeper cue drill). The OTD flow runs light with the bent press in its canonical slot. Thursday closes on a light flow + balance block, never a metabolic finisher.

dayOverview.theme: Thursday KB day, full template, lighter on loaded squatting. Spotlight = windmill (lateral-hinge mobility). OTD flow runs light with the bent press in its canonical slot. TGU is maintenance; the day closes on a light flow + balance block.

spotlights.why: Cycles forward — last spotlighted W11. The lateral hinge is the shared root of the windmill, bent press, and cossack family; drilling the windmill keeps the 'stretch in the back-leg hip flexor, not the lower back' cue sharp and feeds the bent press in the OTD flow. Light bell on Thursday — it's mobility, not load.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: W12 TGU · W13 bent press refresh · W14 figure-8 flow · W15 windmill (current) · W16 cycle forward — TGU or bent-press refresh.
watchpoints: **Thursday = day before Friday legs.** Loaded squatting (OTD-flow front squat, goblet) stays LIGHT — no PR attempts, nothing that pre-fatigues legs.
**Full template** — banded prep → strength → OTD flow → windmill spotlight → mobility → flow + balance → cooldown.
**Windmill spotlight** — 3 rounds, light bell. Hip hinge AWAY from the bell side; the stretch is in the back-leg hip flexor, NOT the lower back.
**OTD flow is the canonical 5-move flow** — dead clean → front squat → lateral lunge → bent press → tactical clean. Bent press is move #4, in the flow, not a separate block. Light groove, 2 rounds.
**Right shoulder watch on the overhead work** (windmill lockout, bent press) — if it talks, lighten and slow down; back off range before grinding.
**Protective shrug greasing set in the warmup (NEW)** — the pull-day behind-back shrug, scattered here because it's cheap and easy to forget. 1 light set, DBs or a bell behind the body.
**Finisher is a light Flow + Balance block, not a metabolic complex.** Thursday is conditioning + skills + balance — and Friday legs is tomorrow.

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 15-20lb. Slow circles, both directions. Shoulder loosener.
Standing, torso hinged slightly forward. Tight fists with thumbs tucked, rotate the wrists internally and hold the tension — wakes the grip and forearms for the flow + clean catches.

exercises.equipment: light DB pair or a kettlebell held behind the body
exercises.notes: **Protective shrug (greasing set) — the pull-day shrug, scattered to KB days.** 1 light set held behind the body (DBs or a bell), palms back. Pack the shoulders DOWN and BACK, shrug UP and slightly back, 1s peak squeeze, slow down. The 'opposite movement' that decompresses the right shoulder — costs nothing, easy to forget.

sets.name: Banded Shoulder Prep (~3 min)

exercises.notes: Mini-band overhead OR blue rope band gripped in hands.
Elbows drive to the ribs, scaps depress.
Press out to a T — fires rear delts and mid-traps.
Pull apart at the sternum, scaps retract, ribs down.
Sweep the arms back. Don't overarch.
15s each side. Primes the lateral hinge — directly preps the windmill + bent press.
Both arms in a V/Y overhead. Hold and breathe — lower traps fire.

sets.notes: 1 round of all 7 banded moves (~3 min). Sustained tension, no rest between positions.

sets.name: Strength Block (Lighter — Thursday Variant)

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 30lb. 2 rounds, 8 each side. Hips hinged, back flat, pull the elbow to the hip.

**LOAD:** 25-30lb. 2 rounds, 5 each side. Single-arm strict press — clean to rack, press straight up.
- **Ribs DOWN** before the press — no rib flare
- **Bicep finishes by the ear, full lockout**
- Slow descent back to the rack

sets.notes: Lighter strength block — single-arm row + press. The bigger compound presses (C&P) are Tuesday's job. ~5 min.

sets.name: OTD Flow (Light Groove — Skill Practice)

exercises.notes: Bell starts on the floor between the feet, hips drive the lift, catch in the rack with the knees slightly bent.
Goblet/rack position. **LIGHT** — Thursday before Friday legs, keep depth without grinding. Sit tall, full depth, no bouncing.
Stride out wide, sit into the working leg, keep the other leg long. Mobility, not strength.

The deliberate leverage move inside the flow — **the body goes DOWN, the bell barely moves.** From the rack, hinge and rotate AWAY from the bell side, eyes tracking the bell, until the arm locks out overhead — you lower your body under the bell, you don't press it up. Slow and smooth; it's leverage, not a press.
Control on the way down — bell to the floor as cleanly as it came up. Closes the flow before switching sides.

sets.notes: **This is a continuous FLOW, not separate stations.** Move through the full chain on ONE side — dead clean → front squat → lateral lunge → bent press → tactical clean — letting each move feed the next, then repeat the whole flow on the other side. About 2 reps' worth at each move, don't stop to count. **~20-25lb throughout, 2 rounds. Light groove** — it should feel effortless. If the 25lb bell is taken, the next bell up (35lb) is the fallback — but keep it light; Friday legs is tomorrow.

sets.name: 🔆 Windmill (Spotlight — Lateral-Hinge Mobility)

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 18-20lb. 3 rounds, 5 each side. Light — this is mobility under load, not a strength lift.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — the lateral hinge, clean:**
- **Bell locked overhead, arm vertical, eyes track the bell** the entire rep — the bell never leaves your sight
- **Hip hinge AWAY from the bell side** — push the hip out toward the bell-arm side, fold over the front leg
- **The stretch lives in the back leg's hip flexor / hamstring and the side of the waist — NOT the lower back.** If you feel it in the lumbar, you're bending the spine instead of hinging the hip
- **Long spine throughout** — the bend is at the hip, the spine stays long (no crunching down)
- **Free hand reaches down the inside of the front leg** toward the floor as the torso lowers
- **Slow descent, brief pause at the bottom, controlled return** — own every inch

**Reflection:** can you keep the stretch in the hip/waist and OUT of the lower back for all 3 rounds? This is the same lateral-hinge pattern as the bent press in the OTD flow — drilling it clean here should make the bent press feel more like leverage and less like a press.

sets.notes: Spotlight mobility flow. 3 rounds at 18-20lb, ~5 min including rest. Light bell — range and clean hinge mechanics are the work.

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 25-30lb. 2 rounds. Maintenance.
- **Straight-arm overhead lockout** — the arm stays locked vertical the whole way
- Eyes ON the bell at every checkpoint
- Pause at every checkpoint — the reverse is half the lift
- Hip bridge: glute squeeze, ribs down

**LOAD:** 15-20lb.
- **Stand on one leg, knee soft, opposite leg lifted slightly**
- Pass the bell around the body — hand to hand behind / in front
- **Standing-leg glute LOCKED IN** — the hip drives stability, not the spine
- 5 reps clockwise, 5 counter-clockwise, then switch legs
- **Torso quiet** — the bell tries to pull you into rotation; resist

sets.name: Flow + Balance — Light Skill Practice

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 15-20lb. Flowing overhead tricep extension into a halo — one continuous shape, a thoracic + shoulder opener under light load. **Flow, don't grind** — smooth circles, ribs down. Right shoulder watch: keep it light and loosening; back off range if it pinches.

**LOAD:** 15-20lb. Single-leg balance + hip hinge. **The point is balance and control, not load** — keep it light so the legs stay fresh for Friday. Standing-leg glute locked, hips square, slow reach to the floor and back. The wobble is the training.
Bodyweight. Slow anti-rotation balance — opposite arm + leg extend, hold 2s, hips stay square (no rotation). Resets the spine after the single-leg work.

sets.notes: Light flow + balance, 2 rounds, ~5 min. Thursday is conditioning + skill + balance — keep it flowing and light; nothing here should pre-fatigue the legs for Friday.

exercises.notes: 60s each side. Hip flexor release — counters the TGU hip bridge and lateral lunge work.
60s. Adductors get tight from lateral lunges and the wide-stance work.

tips: **Thursday** — day before Friday legs. Keep loaded squatting LIGHT (OTD-flow front squat / goblet at ~20lb, no PR attempts).
**Full template** — banded prep → strength → OTD flow → windmill spotlight → mobility → flow + balance → cooldown.
**Spotlight: windmill** (3 rounds, light bell). Hip hinge away from the bell side; stretch in the hip/waist, not the lower back.
**OTD flow is the canonical 5-move flow** — dead clean → front squat → lateral lunge → bent press → tactical clean. Light groove, 2 rounds, ~20-25lb (35lb fallback if 25 is taken).
**Strength block stays lighter** — single-arm row + press only (no C&P, that's Tuesday).
**Finisher = light Flow + Balance block** (overhead-extension-to-halo, single-leg RDL, bird-dog) — flow and balance, not a metabolic complex. Keeps the legs fresh for Friday.
**TGU is maintenance** — sharp cues, light load.
**Right shoulder watch on the windmill lockout + bent press** — lighten and slow down if it talks.
Rotation plan: W16 cycles forward — TGU or bent-press refresh.
formPhilosophy: Thursday KB day, full template, lighter on the loaded squatting because Friday legs is the day after. The windmill spotlight drills the lateral hinge — the shared root of the windmill, bent press, and cossack — so the cue feeds straight back into the OTD flow's bent press. Thursday's identity is conditioning + skill + balance, so the session closes on a light flow + balance block rather than a metabolic finisher. Building decades, not weeks.
